name: Bug example
title: useEffect cleanup updates state after unmount
body: When a component unmounts while a request is in flight, the effect cleanup does not cancel the previous subscription. setState then runs after unmount. This happens on React 18 in Strict Mode. Expected: cleanup cancels the request and no state update is applied. Actual: React warns about a memory leak and the last screen shows stale data.

name: Feature example
title: Add a command to copy the relative path of the active editor
body: Please add a command and keybinding that copies the workspace-relative path of the active editor. Today I can copy the absolute path, but review comments usually need the relative path. A command named workbench.files.action.copyRelativeFilePath would match the existing copy path actions.

name: Question example
title: How do I pin one GPU and enable memory growth?
body: I am running TensorFlow on a shared machine and want one process to use only GPU 1 with memory growth enabled. Which environment variables and tf.config calls should I use, and do they need to run before the first allocation? I am not reporting a crash, I only need the recommended setup.
